title: Client-side control flow into unified storage
answers: How does an API server request reach unified storage?
What implements k8s storage.Interface for Grafana resources?
Where is the gRPC client to unified storage built?
body: pkg/services/apiserver/options/storage.go builds apistore.RESTOptionsGetter (pkg/storage/unified/apistore/restoptions.go:NewRESTOptionsGetterForClient), used by k8s generic.Store per resource. apistore.Storage (pkg/storage/unified/apistore/store.go) implements storage.Interface: Create, Get, GetList, GuaranteedUpdate, Delete, Watch (store.go around lines 315,527,572,703,393,482). Flow per store.go's doc.go diagram: API Server to DualWriter to apistore.Storage to unified.ResourceClient to StorageServer (or to LegacyStorage to LegacyService to SQL for resources not yet migrated). The gRPC client is built in pkg/storage/unified/client.go:ProvideUnifiedStorageClient/newClient, which either calls in-process or hops to a separate unified-grpc service.
